ideas.title: Minnesota Officials' Handling of Autism Program Kickbacks
ideas.description: Investigate Minnesota officials' handling of allegations of kickbacks in the state's autism program
ideas.angle: Follow the money and data analysis to uncover potential fraud and mismanagement
questions: What was the extent of the kickbacks?
What actions were taken by Minnesota DHS?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover significant fraud and mismanagement in Minnesota's Medicaid program. I recommend following the money and analyzing data to identify potential patterns of fraud.

ideas.title: Impact of Trump Administration's Medicaid Funding Freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the Trump administration's Medicaid funding freeze on Minnesota and other states
ideas.angle: Public records and data analysis to understand the effects on healthcare services
questions: What are the effects on healthcare services?
What are the potential long-term consequences?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the significant impact of the Medicaid funding freeze on vulnerable populations. I recommend analyzing public records and data to understand the effects on healthcare services.
